cards.ex: He's quiet, but still waters run deep; I bet he's got some interesting stories.
cards.exUz: U sokin, lekin tinch daryo chuqur; ishonchim komilki, uning qiziqarli hikoyalari bor.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishi sokin odamning ichki dunyosi boy va murakkab bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Just fix that small leak now – a stitch in time saves nine.
cards.exUz: Hoziroq shu kichik sizishni tuzating – vaqtida qilingan tuzatish katta muammoni oldini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni erta bartaraf etish kelajakda katta muammolarning oldini oladi.

cards.ex: I didn't think I could finish the project, but where there's a will, there's a way.
cards.exUz: Men loyihani tugata olaman deb o'ylamagandim, lekin istak bo'lsa, yo'l topiladi.
cards.uzDef: Agar xohish bo'lsa, har qanday qiyinchilikni yengish mumkin.

cards.ex: I hate to complain, but the squeaky wheel gets the grease.
cards.exUz: Shikoyat qilishni yoqtirmayman, lekin g'irchillagan g'ildirak moylanadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat talab qiladigan muammo yoki odam eng ko'p e'tiborga ega bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Be careful buying that; all that glitters is not gold.
cards.exUz: Uni sotib olayotganda ehtiyot bo'ling; har yaltiragan narsa ham oltin emas.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinish har doim ham haqiqiy emas.

cards.ex: I don't usually drink wine, but when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
cards.exUz: Odatda men vino ichmayman, lekin Rimda bo'lsang, rimliklar kabi ish tut.
cards.uzDef: Yangi muhitga moslashish kerak.

cards.ex: He bit off more than he could chew when he agreed to manage three projects.
cards.exUz: U uchta loyihani boshqarishga rozi bo'lib, o'z kuchidan ortiq vazifani oldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z kuchidan ortiq vazifani o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: I missed her terribly when she went away; absence makes the heart grow fonder.
cards.exUz: U ketganida uni juda sog'indim; ayriliq qalbni yanada qadrlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ayriliqda sog'inch kuchayadi, qadrlash ortadi.

cards.ex: Don't bite the hand that feeds you; be respectful to your boss.
cards.exUz: Senga yordam berayotgan odamga yomonlik qilma; xo'jayiningga hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'l.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga yordam bergan insonga yomonlik qilmaslik kerak.

cards.ex: I sometimes think the grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan menga qo'shnining o'ti doim yashilroqdek tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning hayoti biznikidan yaxshiroqdek tuyuladi.

cards.ex: Don't worry, your luck will change; every dog has its day.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olma, omading o'zgaradi; har itning o'z kuni bor.
cards.uzDef: Har kimning ham omadi keladigan kuni bor.

cards.ex: I'm going to double-check everything, better safe than sorry.
cards.exUz: Men hamma narsani qayta tekshirmoqchiman, xavf tug'dirishdan ko'ra ehtiyot bo'lgan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Xavf tug'dirishdan ko'ra, ehtiyot bo'lgan yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: It might not be perfect, but don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
cards.exUz: U mukammal bo'lmasligi mumkin, lekin sovg'aga aytib o'tirmang.
cards.uzDef: Sovg'a qilingan narsani tanqid qilmaslik kerak.

cards.ex: The system works fine; if it ain't broke, don't fix it.
cards.exUz: Tizim yaxshi ishlaydi; ishlayotgan narsani tuzatmang.
cards.uzDef: Ishlayotgan narsani tuzatmang, o'zgartirmang.

cards.ex: He invented that tool out of pure necessity; necessity is the mother of invention.
cards.exUz: U bu asbobni zaruratdan ixtiro qildi; zarurat ixtironing onasi.
cards.uzDef: Zarurat yangi g'oyalar va ixtirolarga turtki bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Let's help each other out; one hand washes the other.
cards.exUz: Keling, bir-birimizga yordam beraylik; qo'l qo'lni yuvadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro yordam muhim.

cards.ex: He shouldn't criticize others; people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarni tanqid qilmasligi kerak; shisha uyda yashovchilar tosh otmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zi xatosiz bo'lmagan odam boshqalarni tanqid qilmasligi kerak.

cards.ex: I'm hesitant to change jobs; the devil you know is better than the devil you don't.
cards.exUz: Men ish joyimni o'zgartirishga ikkilanaman; tanish shayton notanishidan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, noma'lum muammodan ko'ra, tanish muammo yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: They deny the rumors, but where there's smoke, there's fire.
cards.exUz: Ular mish-mishlarni rad etishadi, lekin tutun bo'lsa, olov bor.
cards.uzDef: Agar belgi bo'lsa, unda nimadir sodir bo'lgan.

cards.ex: I'm not sure about the new job, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
cards.exUz: Men yangi ishga ishonchim komil emas, qo'ldagi qush ikki qushdan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Qo'ldagi narsani saqlab qolish, ko'proq narsani izlashdan yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: Quitting smoking is easier said than done.
cards.exUz: Chekishni tashlash aytishdan ko'ra osonroq.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishdan ko'ra aytish osonroq.

cards.ex: Instead of fighting, try to negotiate; the pen is mightier than the sword.
cards.exUz: Urushish o'rniga, muzokara olib boring; qalam qilichdan kuchliroq.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar va yozuvlar zo'ravonlikdan kuchliroq bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Treat people kindly; what goes around comes around.
cards.exUz: Odamlarga mehribonlik qiling; nima eksang, shuni o'rasan.
cards.uzDef: Har bir harakatning oqibati bor.

cards.ex: The office is chaos when the cat's away; everyone is goofing off.
cards.exUz: Mushuk yo'qligida ofisda tartibsizlik; hamma bema'nilik bilan shug'ullanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rahbar yo'qligida, odamlar o'z xohishlaricha harakat qilishadi.

cards.ex: I can give him advice, but you can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.
cards.exUz: Men unga maslahat bera olaman, lekin otni suvga olib borish mumkin, lekin uni ichishga majburlay olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Odamga yordam bera olsangiz ham, uni majburlay olmaysiz.

cards.ex: We both had the same idea! Great minds think alike.
cards.exUz: Ikkalamiz ham bir xil g'oyaga keldik! Buyuklar bir xil fikrlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Aqlli odamlar bir xil g'oyalarga kelishadi.

cards.ex: Even if you're leaving, don't burn your bridges; you might need them later.
cards.exUz: Agar ketsangiz ham, ko'priklarni yoqmang; ular keyinroq kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda kerak bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan aloqalarni buzmaslik kerak.

cards.ex: Let's hope for the best, but prepare for the worst.
cards.exUz: Keling, yaxshilikka umid qilaylik, lekin yomonlikka tayyor bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilikka umid qilish, lekin yomonlikka tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: He meant well, but the road to hell is paved with good intentions.
cards.exUz: Uning niyati yaxshi edi, lekin do'zaxga yo'l yaxshi niyatlar bilan qoplangan.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi niyatlar ham yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Let's work on this together; two heads are better than one.
cards.exUz: Keling, buni birgalikda qilaylik; ikki bosh bir boshdan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda ishlash yolg'iz ishlashdan yaxshiroq.
